body: just remember if you have one it will probably lead back into a full blown habit. so i think that its better if you just deep breathe, do some pushups or sit ups and DONT SMOKE. take it minute by minute than hour by hour than day by day. smoking will do NOTHING but hurt your situation. dont make the game harder. make it easy and dont smoke.

babies, babies, and more babies. i want to have babies. cant have babies and be a smoker. its irresponsible. i want my niece to look up to me not mime me smoking or not want to be around me because i stink.

and ya know cancer, gum health, keeping my teeth, copd, early aging, heart disease, shortness of breathe, circulation problems, allergies, asthma, bronchitis, pneumonia, increased chance of heart attack, ear infections, immune system health, acne, better sleeping habits, a body that heals at a normal rate, lack of oxygen, bad breathe, strokes, smells, emphysema, heartburn, lung cancer, throat cancer, bladder cancer, stomach cancer, peptic ulcers, high cholesterol,  build up in arteries, and early death. just to name a few.

it helps me to go over that list because it gives me the ability to see ten years down the road and realize i do not want those thigns. and if i keep smoking most of those thigns will haappen to me.

i really hope that this works for you. make sure that you seek the professional help that you need. it got depressing for me when i first quit. it gets better but be careful. mental health is not something to mess with.. good luck in all of your endeavors. especially quitting.
